_comment: Config for scan-drift.mjs and validate-skill-examples.mjs, maintained by @drift. roots: folders to scan, relative to the repo root. patterns: { name (matches the registry row), scope, regex (matched per line), flags, extensions, fileRegex (file must also match, e.g. an import), multiline (match regex across the whole file), ignoreComments (skip comment lines), skills }. skillSymbols: per skill, the types/paths/packages its examples reference.
